title: Vertical social clip (9:16)
description: A short vertical clip for a phone feed (a story, a reel, a short) made only from the project's own brand assets: mark, palette tokens, self-hosted type, quoted copy and approved media. 1080 x 1920 by default; the hook lands in the first second and a half.

body.subject: {{focus}}, told with the project's own material: the mark from {{logo_dir}}, the copy quoted verbatim from {{copy_source}}, the media in {{media_dir}}.
body.action: The beats below, in order: a hook in the first {{hook_s}} s (the mark and one short line), the headline, three points one at a time, each held long enough to read (at least {{read_s}} s), then an end card with the mark and one call to action.
body.camera: A fixed vertical 2D frame; motion comes from layers sliding, fading and drawing on, never from a moving virtual camera. One move per layer at a time; stack the layout top to bottom, one idea per screen.
body.style: Large type for a phone held at arm's length, one accent colour, the brand's own fonts; {{palette}}.
body.constraints: Write ONE scene folder: an HTML entry plus its JS, CSS, fonts and images, nothing fetched from elsewhere. Expose window.__scene = {duration_s, width, height}, an async window.__setup() that loads every font and decodes every image, then returns an object with both required arrays. Setup return example: {"fonts":[{"font":"16px Fixture Sans","ok":true}],"images":[{"src":"assets/figure.png","ok":true}]}. Each font or src identifier must be a non-empty string; ok must be a boolean, with true meaning the resource loaded. Empty-resource setup: {"fonts":[],"images":[]} is legitimate when no fonts or images are needed. window.__frame(t) sets EVERY animated property from t (seconds) alone. window.__audit() must return an object with both required arrays describing all visible text and marks at the captured time. Audit return example: {"text":[{"sel":"#title","text":"Title","box":[100,100,500,160],"font_px":28,"opacity":1}],"marks":[{"sel":"figure","box":[600,200,1000,700]}]}. Each row needs a non-empty sel and box=[x0,y0,x1,y1] in viewport pixels, with finite numeric coordinates ordered x0 <= x1 and y0 <= y1. Text rows additionally require string text, positive finite font_px and finite opacity in [0,1]; marks require sel and box. Empty audit: {"text":[],"marks":[]} is legitimate only when no text or marks are visible. No Date, performance.now, Math.random, requestAnimationFrame, CSS animations or CSS transitions: easing and any flicker are closed-form functions of t. The frame is vertical 9:16. All text inside the 5% title-safe area and clear of the top 10% and bottom 20% where a phone's app interface sits, at least {{min_text_px}} px tall at the output size, with contrast of at least 4.5:1 (3:1 at 24 px and up). No text over a busy image without a plate behind it. Quote the copy exactly as written in {{copy_source}}; add no claim it does not make. Frame 0 shows a mark, never an empty frame.

min_text_px.description: the smallest text at the output size; the self-check fails under 22

palette.default: the brand's own tokens from the supplied stylesheet
palette.description: where the colours come from; never invented

logo_dir.description: the project's logo SVGs and fonts

copy_source.description: the project file the copy is quoted from

focus.description: what the clip is about, in one line

hook_s.description: how soon the hook must be on screen

read_s.description: minimum hold for one line of copy

negatives: no text under the phone's app interface

image_references.description: approved project media to place (figures, UI shots)

gates.description: requests other than file: and data: during the render (the scene must be self-contained)
sampled frame with no visible mark: share of pixels carrying a local luminance step
warning only: a nearly empty sampled frame (a weak poster frame)
visible text box outside the 5% title-safe margin
measured contrast of fully visible authored text against the pixels around it (3.0 at 24 px and up)
authored text overlapping a figure or card box
frames differing when the receipt is re-rendered by verify (same engine, sequential order)

provenance.source: Martin 2026-10-09 (issue #8, bug 7): a vertical 9:16 sibling of mg-site-clip, for any project's own assets

beats.action: the hook: the mark and one short line, on screen from frame 0
the headline, then one line of supporting copy
three points, one per screen, each held to read
end card: the mark, one call to action, held
